verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms native iOS and Android apps exist and are described as polished and functional (comm-3, comm-7), and cross-device sync/offline-first architecture (anytype-docs-29, anytype-docs-30) implies capture/linking works across devices, but no documentation explicitly details mobile-specific feature parity for capture, search, and linking, and one long-term user characterizes their mobile use as 'a very basic note system,' hinting at reduced functionality vs desktop. Missing for 10: explicit docs on mobile app feature set (Queries, Graph, Types, Templates) confirming parity with desktop, and independent hands-on reviews of mobile power-user workflows beyond basic notes.
